summary: Explore the latest trends in financial fraud with our course on cryptocurrency and virtual asset risks. Stay informed and protect your investments today.
lede: Cryptocurrency and virtual asset fraud training explains how digital assets reshape fraud risks and what warning signs to assess. It is designed for fraud, compliance, risk, audit, and financial operations professionals who evaluate crypto exposure, investigate suspicious activity, or shape controls. Participants explore scam patterns and transaction red flags, assess onboarding and monitoring controls, and learn the basics of tracing funds and communicating risks to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with fraud risk, compliance, financial operations, or strategic decisions intersecting with cryptocurrency and virtual assets.
audience: Fraud and financial crime investigators or analysts
Banking and microfinance professionals exposed to digital
modules: The New Frontier of Financial Fraud
Cryptocurrency and Virtual Assets Fundamentals for Risk Professionals
Emerging Fraud Typologies in Crypto and Virtual Assets
Red Flags, Risk Indicators, and Transaction Patterns
Risk Assessment and Controls for Crypto and Virtual Assets
Fraud, Cybersecurity, and Operational Risk Intersections
Communicating Crypto and Virtual Asset Risks to Stakeholders
Building a Future-Ready Fraud Risk Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of financial operations and fraud risk management. Familiarity with compliance frameworks is beneficial but not mandatory.
